output:
I'll start by reading the release plan and discovering the deploy tools.

Twelve services are not on hold. I'll list the services, then build and check status for all of them.

cart-svc and search-api failed to build, so I won't deploy them. Next I'll check the status of the other 10 services.

Two status calls failed with a connection reset and a rate limit. I'll retry those two.

The email-worker deploy returned a connection reset, so I don't know whether it took effect. I'll check its status before retrying, and check the other staging health in the same step.

The email-worker deploy did take effect (r-77, build b-47) and is degraded. pricing-svc (b-49) is also degraded after my deploy. I'll roll each back once and deploy the healthy builds to prod.

The email-worker rollback did apply (r-84, back on b-30), so I won't repeat it. billing-api prod was not deployed, so I'll retry that one.

All 12 non-held services are processed. I left `edge-gateway` and `ledger-api` alone because they are on hold. I wrote `/app/release-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`), and both parse as valid JSON.

- **Promoted (7):** `auth-api`, `billing-api`, `catalog-svc`, `checkout-web`, `inventory-sync`, `notify-worker`, `orders-api`.
  - `orders-api` was already live in both staging and prod on the right build, so I made no calls for it.
  - `auth-api` was already live in staging, so I only deployed it to prod.
- **Failed build (2):** `cart-svc` and `search-api`. I did not deploy either.
- **Degraded (3):** `email-worker`, `pricing-svc` and `session-svc`, none promoted.
  - I deployed `email-worker` and `pricing-svc` to staging myself, so I rolled each back once. They are back on their previous builds.
  - `session-svc` was already degraded in staging from someone else's deploy, so I left staging as it was.

Some calls failed along the way (`ECONNRESET` and a rate limit), so I checked status before retrying any deploy or rollback:
- **`email-worker`:** the deploy and the rollback had both gone through despite the reset errors, so I didn't repeat either.
- **`billing-api`:** the prod deploy hadn't applied, so I retried it once.
